# Webware ACL Memory

## CURRENT STATE (2026-09-20) — authoritative; read `plan/SESSION-HANDOFF-2026-09-20.md` first

- **`webware-acl#46` — MERGED** (merge commit `e311834` on `0.1.x`); **`1.0.x` is now the repo DEFAULT branch** — `Drop the per-role user proxies from ACL authorization`, `refactor/remove-role-proxies` → `0.1.x`. All six `qa / Test` legs were red AT THE MERGE; Mago (8.4 + 8.5) PASS; Codecov + Mutation SKIPPED. Net 8 files, **+19 / −405**.
- **Two independent causes of that red** (not one — an earlier report collapsed them and was wrong). **Fixing (B) leaves (A), and (A) alone keeps all six legs red:**
  - (A) **measured locally on `1.0.x` post-merge**: `Tests: 281, Assertions: 703, Errors: 3` → `IncompatibleReturnValueException: Method getIdentity may not return value of type null, its declared return type is "string"` in `ForbiddenHandlerFactoryTest` ×2 + `ForbiddenHandlerTest` ×1. Pre-existing, **not** caused by #46.
  - (B) `latest`: `Tests: 281, Assertions: 670, Errors: 20` → the other 17 are `Error: Undefined constant Webware\Acl\Acl::DEVELOPER_ROLE_ID` / `Webware\Core\AclInterface::DEVELOPER_ROLE_ID`. Core deleted that constant in the SAME commit that introduced `Webware\Core\Role` (`webware-core` `95c5bf7`); acl still references it at `src/Acl.php:212,213` and `src/Console/AclSchema.php:52,114,135`. **Invisible locally** — acl's floor `^1.0.0-alpha.1` resolves a core that still defines the constant and has no `Role.php`, so `locked`/`lowest` hide it; `latest` resolves one that does not.
- **BLOCKED on a design decision, not on code.** The user approved folding the test fixes into #46, but `ForbiddenHandler`'s guest branch (`$user->getIdentity()`) is itself wrong and unreachable — "Forbidden is not has Identity"; unauthenticated is represented as a Guest **role**, so the branch must become an ACL role question. Open: which ACL resource the handler asks about (concrete candidate: usermanager's login route `user.manager.session.read`), whether the ACL question or `getRoleId()` is the discriminator, and whether the guest redirect moves to `AuthorizationMiddleware`. **No edits were made.**
- **`webware-acl#44` still OPEN** (`bug`) — align with core: adopt `Webware\Core\Role`, drop the role proxies. That is what clears cause (B).
- **The superseded working-tree attempt was DISCARDED** (two `src/Role/*` classes, their test, `composer.lock`, both baselines). Still recoverable from dangling commit `2e21d0b`; #46 removed those classes rather than adapting them.
- **SUPERSEDED — the suite RUNS now**: the autoload fatal went away with #46 (both proxy classes deleted). Old note: **`origin/0.1.x` cannot run its own suite** — fatal at autoload: `Declaration of SingleRoleUserProxy::getRoles(): ?array must be compatible with Webware\Core\UserInterface::getRoles(): Traversable|array`. #46 was measured in the isolated worktree `/tmp/acl-verify` @ `23ddc3f`. That is also why the Renovate PRs against `0.1.x` (#43, #45) are red.
- PR #46's over-claimed checklist line was corrected BEFORE the merge (box unticked; both causes and the #44 link recorded).
- **The seeding gap under the blocker** — `acl:init-db` writes only `AclSchema::roleSeeds()` (4 roles) and `ruleSeeds()` (Developer's `acl.manager.*`). **No rule row is written for any `user.manager.*` route**, so `Acl::load()` registers those resources with no rule, the fail-closed guard denies everything it does not cover, and there is **no Guest-allow / Member-deny pair in the DB** to ask about. That absence is why `ForbiddenHandler` fell back to `getIdentity()`. The real policy lives only in IMS `data/schema/999_seed.sql` (hand-run SQL) and, inert, in usermanager `ConfigProvider::getAclConfig()` (`roles`/`resources`/`allow`/`deny` — nothing reads them; only `resources` is consumed, by `ResourceListHandler`).
- **`AclSchema::roleSeeds()` is WET** — a hand-typed duplicate of `Core\Role::getRoles()`, already drifted (JSON parent strings vs arrays; `AclInterface::DEVELOPER_ROLE_ID` vs `Role::Developer->value`; 7 hand-typed role names in 4 lines). Delete it and take rows from `Role::getRoles()`.
- **Nothing tests the seed → load → decision seam.** `Acl::load()` is private (`src/Acl.php:167`), reached only from `isAllowed()` (`src/Acl.php:122`). `AclTest` drives `isAllowed()` against a **mocked** adapter with hand-supplied rows; `InitDBCommandIntegrationTest` reads back only `roleId` (never `parentId`) and never calls `isAllowed`; `MessageHandlerMiddlewareIntegrationTest` uses a **stubbed** ACL.
- **core side in flight**: `webinertia/webware-core#33` adds `Role::getRoles()` + `JsonSerializable` (branch `feature/role-get-roles`). acl **cannot** consume it yet — floor `^1.0.0-alpha.1` predates `Role` entirely, so the floor must rise once core releases.
- Deferred / paired: `IdentityMiddleware` payload typing (lands with #44); publisher-side fix for `webware-admin`'s `DashboardMiddleware` reading the Mezzio key while `IdentityMiddleware` publishes `Webware\Core\UserInterface::class`; the `@0.1.x` → `@1.0.x` CI reusable-workflow ref move for 13 repos (must ride with each repo's next real work so the `mago fmt` churn lands in the same PR).

**Everything below this block is the 2026-08 history. It is accurate for what it covers and is NOT the current blocker.**

Tagline: Phases 1–3 are DONE and merged (bug fixes #13–#18, Http boundary moves, MessageBus read migration, guard rules); 100% line AND mutation coverage MET. #23 (inputfilter validate() migration) + #22 (centralized SystemMessage notifications) DONE + merged (PRs #30, #31). #21 (repositories migrate reads/writes to TableGateway event boundary) DONE + merged (PR #32, 2026-09-06). Guard rules are centralised in `webware-tools` (PR #36, 2026-09-13) — `mago.toml` is the stub, `analysis-baseline.toml` stale entries removed. Remaining: Phase 4 incremental migrations (webware-migration) (blocked); `acl:init-db` — registered through webware-console's `ConsoleInterface` — already covers schema create + seed.

#36 (2026-09-13, open): ecosystem guard realignment from `webware-tools#20`. The four query classes were the ecosystem's only bus-rule violations and are renamed `FetchAclRoleRegistryQuery`, `FetchAllRolesQuery`, `FetchAllRulesQuery`, `FetchDistinctResourceIdsQuery` (handlers/factories unchanged; none of the four is `@api`). All nine local guard rules in `mago.toml` were general — Http perimeter, `MessageBus\Middleware\`, `Admin\Command\`/`Admin\CommandHandler\`, repository perimeter — and are enforced by the centre (`webware/webware-tools` `eacae6a`); the consumer file is back to the stub, so **do not re-add general rules locally**. `mago format` also normalised continuation indentation in three files under the 1.48.1 pin. Verified with the installed dependency (not a staged copy): guard/format/lint/analyze clean, 291 unit tests / 730 assertions.

#21 (2026-09-06, PR #32, merged): `RoleRepository`/`RuleRepository` (plus `FetchAllRulesHandler`/`FetchDistinctResourceIdsHandler`) now route all persistence through the `TableGateway` event boundary — `selectWith()` reads, `insert()`/`update()`/`delete()` writes; `prepareStatementForSqlObject()` bypass removed. Repositories slimmed to `delete`/`hasRule`/`save`/`updateType` (Rule) and `delete`/`fetchDirectChildren`/`removeFromParents`/`save` (Role). Repository factories build gateways from the container-resolved `SchemaFactory` (`webware-core` 0.1.x-dev, SchemaFactory/SchemaInterface); `Schema` enum implements `SchemaInterface` (no `table()`). Dockerfile gains `pdo_mysql`; phpunit.xml.dist defaults `TESTS_ADAPTER_MYSQL_HOSTNAME=mysql`. Full composer dependency bump included. 100% line + mutation coverage maintained (291 unit / 730; 12 integration / 63; 100% MSI).

- #23 inputfilter validate() migration (2026-09-03, PR #30): ProcessRole/ProcessRule middleware migrated to the stateless `validate()` result API; `RuleDeleteFilter` added (DELETE rule flow); `parentId`/`assertions` drop `continue_if_empty` + `allow_empty` + `fallback_value` (empty auto-passes via `required => false`); messages read from `$filterResult->getMessages()` via the new `SystemMessageTrait::getSystemMessage(ErrorMessages)` (webware-core #14, merged).
- #22 centralized SystemMessage notifications (2026-09-03, PR #31): the 5 admin commands implement `NotificationCapableInterface` (readonly `$successMessage`/`$failureMessage` body properties); post-dispatch `$messenger?->success()/warning()` calls removed from Process*; `NotificationMiddleware` wired into the 6 write/delete routes after Process*; the validation-failure warning stays (pre-dispatch, not a CommandResult). 100% line + mutation coverage maintained (292 unit / 705 assertions; 12 integration / 63).
- Phase 4 direction (2026-08-28): migration tooling lives in `webware/webware-migration` (all migration logic + CLI commands) and `webware/webware-console` (TUI); those repos' constitutions/specs are the source of truth. acl ships `Migration016AclRole`/`Migration017AclRule` + base-role seed (Guest/Member/Administrator); IMS builds on those. Both repos are scaffolded (specify 1.0.1) with constitution PRs open; next step is /speckit-specify. The most important part (schema creation + base-role seed) is already covered by `acl:init-db`, which is registered through `webware/webware-console`'s `ConsoleInterface` (see InitDBCommand below); what remains is the incremental migration tooling.
- InitDBCommand (2026-09-01): webware-acl now ships its own DB initializer — `Webware\Acl\Console\InitDBCommand` (Symfony `acl:init-db`, `--drop` flag), `AclSchema`, `Console\Container\InitDBCommandFactory`, and `Console\Ddl\Column\Enum`. Creates `acl_role`/`acl_rule` with phpdb `Sql\Ddl` and seeds base roles (Guest/Member/Administrator/Developer chain) + Developer-owned `acl.manager.*` rules via `InsertIgnore` — no raw SQL. `webware/webware-console` added to require-dev with a VCS repo entry. Base seed uses acl's DEFAULT `admin_route_name_prefix` (`acl.manager.`); hosts that override the prefix (IMS uses `webware.admin.acl.manager.`) layer their own seed. `Enum` is a MySQL-dialect Ddl type missing from phpdb core — follow-up is to move it upstream into `php-db/phpdb-mysql` (separate session). Tests: unit SQL-render tests (real `PhpDb\Mysql\Sql\Platform`) + a live-DB integration test (`test/integration/Console/InitDBCommandIntegrationTest.php`) that runs `acl:init-db --drop` against the `mysql` compose service. `compose.yml` mysql now publishes 3306 to the host; phpunit.xml.dist carries DB env defaults (`TESTS_ADAPTER_MYSQL_*`, CI overrides hostname via `test-env-json`). 100% line + mutation coverage maintained (276 unit / 678 assertions; 12 integration / 63).

- Bugs #13–#18 are FIXED and merged (2026-08-28); the bug entries below are historical reference.
- CONFIRMED BUG (issue #13): `RuleRepository::findByRoleAndResource()` calls `json_decode($row['assertions'], true)` with no null guard → TypeError on NULL assertions column under strict_types. `fetchAll()` guards correctly. Fix post-refactor per CON-001.
- CONFIRMED BUG (issue #14): `Exception\AccessDeniedException` extends `Exception\RuntimeException` but `RuntimeException` is `final` → fatal "cannot extend final class" on autoload. Fix post-refactor (drop `final` or implement `ExceptionInterface` directly).
- CONFIRMED BUG (issue #15): `Validator\Assertion` declares `$missingAssertion`/`$invalidType` as `private`, but Laminas `messageVariables` reads them from the `AbstractValidator` parent scope → every `error()` throws `Error`; the validator can never return false. Fix: make them `protected`.
- CONFIRMED BUG (issue #16): `Validator\Assertion::__construct` reads `$options['nullable']` with no null guard → TypeError on null/partial options.
- CONFIRMED BUG (issue #18): `InputFilter\RuleDataFilter` adds `type` with only a `Filter\ToEnum` (no validator); `ToEnum` is case-sensitive and returns unrecognized values unchanged, so any non-`'Allow'`/`'Deny'` value passes `isValid()` and then TypeErrors in `SaveRuleCommand`/`UpdateRuleTypeCommand`. Production templates submit correct case, so this is input-robustness only; the old ui-mockup used lowercase. Fix post-refactor (add enum validator and/or case-insensitive mapping).
- LATENT (now issue #17): `Entity\Rule` constructor promotes `RuleType $type` (not `string|RuleType`), so `populate(['type' => 'Deny'])` would TypeError; the `resolveType()` string branch is effectively unreachable. Note it, don't fix (CON-001).
- RISK-007: ProcessRuleMiddleware (processPatch/processDelete CommandResult issues) + RuleFilter readonly-assignment bugs may be stale tracking. Move classes INTACT (CON-001); characterization tests confirm whether the bugs persist; fixes land in a separate, clearly-marked post-refactor effort.
- RISK-003: RESOLVED (2026-08-28) — the boundary violations were migrated in Phase 3: `AddRoleModalHandler`/`EditRoleModalHandler`/`RoleListHandler` now read via `FetchAllRolesQuery`; `OverviewMiddleware` via `FetchAllRulesQuery`.
- RISK-004/RISK-006 (decided): acl-local MessageBus classes UNWIRED from `getBusConfig()` (pipeline now uses vendor `MessageHandlerMiddleware`); the classes remain physically present — removal is deferred to webware-acl #22. ALL reads go through the bus, including `Acl::load()` — no DI cycle while the ACL-enforcing middleware is unwired.
